people.title: главный куратор

basis: The studio's own team page (tikhaya.org/team) names Artem Filatov, who founded it in 2015, as director and Alisa Savitskaya as chief curator.
The museum's contacts page, updated 15 October 2026, names Elena Novikova as head of the institution; no page found dates the departure of the former director Nailya Allakhverdieva.
The gallery's information page links the Perm Krai culture ministry order of 19 September 2025 reappointing Yulia Tavrizyan as director from 23 September 2025 on a new fixed term contract.
The museum's own contacts page lists Ekaterina Teryukova as museum director.

The Hermitage site would not load; the Manege board page, which already lists the Tretyakov director appointed in January 2026, names Mikhail Piotrovsky as general director of the Hermitage since 1992.
The gallery's own About page team list names Daria Kolpashnikova as general director and Anastasia Albokrinova as curator.
The Manege team page (manege.spb.ru/team/management) names Anna Yalova as director.
